name: missing_ticker_spy_substitution
description: Ticker 'XYZ' is absent from all 30 historical days; SPY is present every day. When XYZ is not in day_data, the returns_matrix cell is set to spy_ret (line 491 fallback). All portfolio returns are therefore identical to the SPY daily returns. With current_symphony_return=0.3 (last_percent_change=0.003) and historical SPY returns in +/-0.5 range, roughly half the simulated paths exceed 0.3 -> prob ~50%. This pins that the missing-ticker fallback produces a valid, finite result in [0, 100].
derivation: XYZ absent from all days -> returns_matrix uses spy_ret (the missing-ticker SPY substitution). historical SPY returns are +-0.005 -> +-0.5 pct after scaling. current_symphony_return = 0.003 * 100 * 1.0 = 0.3. Re-captured from the fixed producer at branch fix/mc-knn-exit-gate HEAD 7ff61a4 (Cluster 2) with run_monte_carlo(..., seed=42). The value shifted from the pre-Cluster-2 48.38 because AC-1 standardizes the kNN feature vector and AC-4 excludes the early-window days — both intentionally change neighbour selection. Provenance: captured-from-the-fixed-producer.
